title: Canon of the Rebounding Wrong
summary: A canon on a field that waits for a wrong to be done and sends it back to its doer in the same shape and weight.

title: Treatise of Weighed Deeds
summary: A treatise on weighing every deed a foe has done in the field and pressing down on them by that sum.

title: The Debt Collector's Mastery
summary: A mastery of claiming what is owed: liens on the foe's qi and bonds on the limbs until the whole debt is paid.

title: The Oath of Equal Return
summary: A sworn manual of exact repayment: the oath-taker gives back blow for blow and harm for harm and takes no more.

title: Manual of the Unpaid Account
summary: A manual of the harm left unpaid on purpose and collected all at once when the foe is at their weakest.

title: Mastery of the Turning Wheel
summary: A mastery of the whole wheel of deed and fruit: good returns as strength to allies and harm returns as ruin to foes.
